intent: Audit all 44 open non-PR reports through #1145, preserve existing fixes and concurrent source changes, improve missing diagnosis, and provide honest per-issue closure evidence. Each disposition remains conditional on the complete composed source and final-head qualification.
closure_policy: The requested closure may include diagnostic resolutions. Each note must preserve its remaining qualification; issue closure is not a declaration of full live/device acceptance.
privacy: No original prompts, private endpoints, repository names from report payloads, identifiers, credentials, raw tool arguments or raw logs are stored in this audit.

existing_pr_regressions.qualification: Historical suite totals in that document are not relabeled as a rerun of the final PR head. Listed Android/Compose/Robolectric suites remain part of exact-head qualification.

concurrent_source_regressions.qualification: Graph/workflow/prerequisite and preflight tests are retained from the concurrent source changes. Current status/report regression results are recorded separately; exact-head CI still qualifies the complete application.

current_recovery_kotlin.scope: Current changed production report/projection/status/checkpoint/integration-report sources; cached surrounding planner classes and stubbed Android/report-storage boundaries. This is not a full Android or device test.
current_recovery_kotlin.results: After reconciliation to 0a340a91, the source-pinned local harness passed all 61 cases including its policy-access recovery regression. Final publication still requires exact-head repository CI gates.

current_reporter_python.scope: Approved report contract, closed types/enums and application reporter readiness. Service deployment is not implied by local tests.

current_ktlint.scope: Ten Kotlin source/test files in the combined diagnostic/status scope, after reconciliation to 0a340a91.

late_report_followup.scope: Actual provider catch sites, emitted repository error values, approved report projection and capability-negotiated delivery; historical incidents remain unreproduced.
late_report_followup.qualification: Focused local contract receipts and final hosted Android execution are recorded in PR #1122. A source or host-fixture pass does not establish physical-device or private-provider reproduction.
late_report_followup.host_boundary: Current report/context/codes/capsule/diagnostics/submission transport are compiled; Android Build, storage and surrounding provider ports remain stubbed. New real Robolectric, adapter and repository integration regressions require hosted Android execution.

handoff_report_followup.scope: Actual handoff session reconciliation observations and report projection, matched against remaining identities; combined handoff/delivery/freshness approved-report contracts and negotiated hosted delivery.
handoff_report_followup.qualification: The prior head's CI receipts remain discovery evidence. The final combined head must pass all applicable repository, Android, device, Gateway and packaging gates; historical original tool outcomes remain unproven.
handoff_report_followup.host_boundary: Current handoff session/helper and report/contract/submission sources were compiled with portable supports and cached or stubbed platform boundaries. These passes do not qualify Android persistence, the external collector, real durable-file recovery, providers or physical devices.
handoff_report_followup.canonical_qualification: Canonical checks passed after local app-inventory regeneration for this source subset. Complete composed source must regenerate its own inventories and pass all applicable final-head gates.

delivery_report_followup.qualification: The collector component and closed contract are integrated. Actual final-head Android collector/persistence execution and all applicable gates remain required. No historical provider cause is inferred.

freshness_report_followup.scope: Four verification-time predicates retained with checked claims; old/incomplete observations remain unavailable. Report-contract local validation is recorded in handoff_report_followup.
freshness_report_followup.qualification: The V2 producer and closed report contract are integrated. Original status/reason/recovery logic and historical/immutable exceptions are unchanged. Focused source-host results do not replace final Android execution, and no historical freshness condition is inferred.
freshness_report_followup.host_boundary: Current complete policy/book/projector and frozen real schema/capsule with cached surrounding helper/platform boundaries; full Android and context-admission qualification is still required.

query_precheck_followup.scope: Conditional nonblank repository-search query validation, typed native backstop and existing bounded field-evidence projection.
query_precheck_followup.qualification: Final composed operation/native/report regressions must execute. Missing search text or repository identity is never invented and target admission remains strict.

read_guidance_followup.qualification: The complete compact description retains exclusive line-limit, bounded EOF and source continuation guidance. Full context admission and final source composition still require qualification.

preflight_stage_followup.host_boundary: Actual current ToolFailureMetadata, ToolResultEnvelope, GitHubDispatchAccounting, NetworkFailureKind, ErrorClassification and ToolAuthorizationRejected compiled; exact current result/exception declarations extracted. Current cached report/capsule/context hashes verified. Established Android/network/storage boundary substitutes documented in sources.json; no Android or ToolEventRecorder runtime execution claimed.

issues.observed_problem: Voice setup was reported unavailable; completion of a model transfer alone did not establish both engines were ready.
issues.resolution: Retain independent recognition-pack and speech-pack readiness, download/install scheduler state, failure category and progress. Existing readiness gates still require usable engine assets before enabling the corresponding route.

issues.observed_problem: Playback failed when Android did not grant audio focus.
issues.resolution: The local speech output retries the initial focus rejection once within the existing session boundary and records focus-attempt count, focus outcome and terminal playback failure. No indefinite retry or false playback-start signal is introduced.
issues.remaining_qualification: A persistent external focus owner can still deny playback. The affected phone contention was not reproduced, and a host/emulator result does not establish physical audio output.
issues.closure_basis: Improved diagnosis and bounded recovery; the historical external outcome is not claimed fixed.

issues.observed_problem: Microphone capture was unavailable or silenced and surfaced VOICE_MICROPHONE_BUSY.
issues.resolution: The local recognizer may recreate the recorder once only for a retryable zero-sample start. Capture-attempt count, reads, captured/nonzero samples, silence, permission and focus observations remain distinct. Existing callbacks, cancellation and half-duplex guards remain active.
issues.remaining_qualification: Another app or Android policy can still hold the microphone. No report is classified as a successful capture merely because audio focus was granted, and the historical physical-device conflict was not replayed.
issues.closure_basis: Improved diagnosis and bounded recovery; the historical external outcome is not claimed fixed.

issues.observed_problem: Live voice captions could show the wrong text or lose the reader position while following speech.
issues.resolution: The themed caption surface keeps the complete text and validates observed speech ranges. Automatic movement does not detach following; explicit manual reading does, and returning to the bottom resumes it. Invalid/stale ranges cannot highlight another utterance, and text timing is not fabricated.
issues.remaining_qualification: Exact spoken-word highlighting requires engine-provided ranges that map to the displayed text. Kokoro currently supplies no range callback, so exact-word synchronization is unavailable on that route; other routes may report NO_TIMING or TEXT_UNMAPPED. Bounded voice_engine, voice_phase and voice_caption_alignment observations identify the active route and observed alignment state for recurrence. Caption regressions cover text, Unicode ranges and following; exact-head Compose verification remains required, and no physical audio alignment is claimed.
issues.closure_basis: Partial caption repair plus timing diagnostics under the requested fallback policy; exact-word Kokoro synchronization and the historical physical-device outcome are not claimed fixed.

issues.observed_problem: Integration acceptance stopped with CAPABILITY_PREREQUISITES_MISSING: 45 of 70 required capabilities were verified, 18 had input blockers and 7 had approval blockers. The retained sample had 14 remote continuation recipes and 173 calls remaining.
issues.resolution: Concurrent b9f3a36c and 0a340a91 prepare the selected revision graph through its existing checkpoint flow and follows issued exact-SHA workflow continuation pages to find an executed job under a bounded dependency allowance. They make fixture approval settings and source prerequisites actionable, retain typed graph/workflow dependency observations, and do not mark an unindexed graph verified. This change adds report-safe retained preparation state/counts, fixture-creation admissibility and a bounded sample of blocked operation families with an omitted-family count. The stop summary counts missing repository/ref/source inputs.
issues.remaining_qualification: 45/70 remains partial historical coverage. Remaining budget does not authorize fixture mutations, create missing resources, choose a different revision, or verify pending operations. A bounded smoke sample cannot be reported as full inventory. Failed/uncertain graph indexing must be reconciled; missing baseline, logs, nodes and approval remain prerequisites. New report fields require a reporter deployment advertising ACCEPTANCE_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_V1.
issues.closure_basis: Source repair with regression evidence; environment qualifications remain explicit.

issues.observed_problem: Repository Health had six of seven observations verified. Applicable rules were observed, while branch protection was not found or inaccessible, so required-check policy remained unknown.
issues.resolution: Concurrent b9f3a36c and 0a340a91 retain separate policy-endpoint HTTP observations, actionable access text and a clearly partial policy summary in the status checkpoint. This change projects actual numeric HTTP status, actual branch-protected/completeness flags and a closed endpoint-specific recovery hint into approved reports. An inaccessible policy endpoint requests REFRESH_REPOSITORY_ACCESS with automatic retry disabled; other unavailable reads retain RESOLVE_CAPABILITY_PREREQUISITE. Neither is a generic unfinished-work replay.
issues.remaining_qualification: A protection 404 cannot establish absence; protected=false and empty observed rules cannot establish complete policy. This code cannot grant repository permissions. Recheck authentication/policy read access and refresh the same selected branch at its current head. Unknown policy remains unverified. New report fields require a reporter deployment advertising ACCEPTANCE_RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_V1.
issues.closure_basis: Improved diagnosis and bounded recovery; the historical external outcome is not claimed fixed.

issues.observed_problem: The old build 141 report retained CHAT_FAILED with an absent code, unknown origin and no run, provider, exception or causal identity. It has no external attachment. The report cannot establish the failing provider or original cause.
issues.resolution: Preserve safe exception type, bounded application frames and hashed cause types at actual Gemini, Groq, Ollama and LiteRT catch sites. Preserve typed failure details and cancellation. Normal repository-emitted errors also retain their observed repository boundary and owning run/selected provider when missing, including Continue without a saved original. No Throwable, HTTP response, dispatch, recovery authority or causal origin is invented for message-only values. The new capture sites require CAPTURE_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE_V1 for hosted delivery; saved approvals remain unchanged until support is available, and native authenticated GitHub delivery is independent.
issues.remaining_qualification: The historical CHAT_FAILED has not been reproduced or assigned a cause. Install the updated app and, for hosted delivery, deploy a reporter advertising CAPTURE_BOUNDARY_EVIDENCE_V1. Reproduce on the original route with opt-in diagnostics to obtain actual boundary/exception evidence. Device and private-provider behavior are not established by unit tests.
issues.closure_basis: The requested diagnostic fallback is implemented; closure does not assert the historical failure mechanism is fixed.

issues.observed_problem: An old build 141 full-catalog capability check verified 45 of 118 capabilities, with 66 blocked and 7 untested, zero failed operations, zero unresolved outcomes and 173 calls remaining. issues.resolution: The existing exact-revision graph and workflow preparation now prioritizes eligible dependency reads before issuing an incomplete verdict. The report records actual preparation state, ready-call counts, fixture admissibility and blocked operation families, plus graph/workflow dependency observations. Compared with #1127, the broader catalog adds 47 owned-fixture and one live-evidence blocker; matching verified/call totals do not make distinct run identities the same run.

ASK/CONDITIONAL approval does not authorize fixture creation, and Continue cannot supply missing owned resources, cleanup authority or live evidence. No claim is made that all 118 capabilities are verified. Hosted delivery of the new recovery fields requires the advertised recovery/prerequisite/graph capabilities.

The entire 71-character description survives compact discovery. Actual generated ordinary-repository wire remains 2,996 UTF-8 bytes / 999 estimated tokens under the unchanged strict below-1,000 regression. Existing parser/schema constraints, valid path-only/count/EOF reads, continuation behavior, bounded argument repair and replay authority remain unchanged.

The change improves pre-call guidance; it does not promise a model will never submit invalid arguments. Final full Android/context-admission validation must qualify the combined candidate.

issues.observed_problem: The installed b5ab42bf/build 141 report retains an unsupported acceptance verdict with one required criterion, none verified and two unresolved claims. The recorded reasons are MUTABLE_EVIDENCE_EXPIRED_OR_REVISION_CHANGED and OBSERVATION_TIME_UNKNOWN. Two linked eligible receipts and 485 remaining calls do not establish supported fresh claims or authorization to retry. The old combined reason strings cannot distinguish nonpositive/absent/malformed observation time from a future time, or mutable age-limit failure from an epoch mismatch.
issues.resolution: The candidate captures a bounded closed set of effective freshness predicates during the existing verification call and retains that observation with each checked claim/verdict. The report projects only recorded OBSERVATION_TIME_UNAVAILABLE, OBSERVATION_TIME_FUTURE, MUTABLE_AGE_EXCEEDED and MUTABLE_EPOCH_MISMATCH values through acceptance_claim_freshness_predicates. Old or incomplete retained annotations remain unavailable. CLAIM_FRESHNESS_EVIDENCE_V1 negotiates the new report vocabulary, including omitted fields, so an older hosted reporter retains the exact approved bytes without POST; native authenticated GitHub delivery remains independent. Existing status/reason/recovery decisions, immutable and stable-number exceptions, permitted historical observations and bounded refresh rules remain unchanged.
